alternate_mechanisms.name: speech_that_wounds_or_reconciles
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The bestowed mouth can assault, lie, testify face to face, handle people tactfully, preserve good public mention, and challenge an unjust arrangement. Speech becomes accountable when it helps move knowledge toward liberation and provision rather than toward hostility or reputation alone.

alternate_mechanisms.name: disciplined_valuation_of_the_costly_way
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Clear guidance opposes visual mis-sizing, dullness, loose judgment, and heedless shortcoming. Discernment and composed bearing revalue the steep path correctly: costly aid is not irrational loss, while neglect of the vulnerable is not ease or success.

alternate_mechanisms.name: assisted_ascent_and_rehabilitative_release
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Supported gait, heel-trace, sweat, loosened joint, bodily touch, and administered care turn ascent into assisted rehabilitation. Liberation restores movement and agency, and the climber's own progress is imagined as relational rather than self-sufficient.

alternate_mechanisms.name: famine_displacement_and_the_need_to_stay
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Drought drives movement through desert isolation and urgent water-seeking, while provision enables a person or household to remain settled. Feeding during masghabah therefore counters both hunger and the displacement pressure that can end in dust-level destitution.

alternate_mechanisms.name: household_continuity_for_unsupported_dependents
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Household transfer, unsupported womanhood, bereavement, descendants, inheritance, kinship, and household inhabitants map the relational structures that can fail around a dependent person. The related orphan's need is thus part of a broader continuity-and-protection problem, without changing the surface recipient.

alternate_mechanisms.name: release_followed_by_reintegration
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Emancipation separates a person from coercive closure; graft acceptance, nearness, nurture, and dwelling supply the complementary movement into sustaining life. The mechanism guards against imagining freedom as abandonment after a single legal act.

alternate_mechanisms.name: the_cosmic_bowl_of_the_poor
alternate_mechanisms.summary: A star cluster called the bowl of the poor connects celestial time, navigation, continuity, and a water vessel to the feeding of the miskin. It offers a memorable cosmic-provision analogue but remains remote because no nocturnal or stellar object appears in 90:9-16.

alternate_mechanisms.name: adornment_displaced_by_bodily_need
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Shoulder and chest ornament, core property, wealth, poverty, and food intake create a contrast in resource use. What could mark status on the body is displaced by the claims of the bound neck and hungry body; jewelry and weaponry remain only analogical.
